image.custom_prompt:
Turn this exact CityPrompt frame into a convincing live-action photograph of the completed development in crisp neutral daylight. Rebuild the flat materials and coarse photogrammetry surfaces as real glass, masonry, paving and natural planting. Keep the camera, perspective, framing and every building's scale and position unchanged.

The complete two-storey pitched-roof building left of the woman must retain both window rows, roof form and footprint. The large Calgary glass tower with white diagonal lattice fills the upper central background and continues beyond the top edge: keep it that close and large, with the same occlusion by trees. Keep the other background buildings at their shown sizes. Do not move the skyline into the distance or expose hidden geometry. Keep the plaza, benches, planting beds, trees, lamps and paths in their exact positions. Keep the adult woman viewed from behind in the same pose, orange jacket, dark trousers and white shoes. Preserve other visible people. Make them photographic. Where sky is visible, use clean blue daylight. No added buildings, people, vehicles, signs, camera widening or changed floor counts.

review.review_method: Viewed the native source frame and the full generated still side by side in conversation before video submission
passed: Complete two-storey pitched-roof building remains visible left of the walking subject
Large white-diagrid glass skyline landmark remains close, tall and cropped by the upper frame
Main path, lamp row, planting beds, trees, benches and orange-jacket subject retain recognizable layout
Photographic materials, natural planting and neutral daylight replace the flat polygon appearance
limitations: Surface and some facade/planting detail are AI reconstructions, not verified as-built architectural evidence
Output is 1672 by 941 pixels, approximately the original 16:9 aspect; reference bytes remain unmodified
A suitable still does not establish that Omni will preserve its skyline or photographic finish in motion

video.custom_prompt: Turn this original 3D walk into live-action cinema using Image1 for the photographic finish. Retain Video1's camera, walking motion and exact scene layout. Keep the complete two-storey building on the left and the large Calgary skyline at the same apparent scale and positions. Real people, detailed materials, natural planting and crisp neutral daylight. One continuous four-second shot.
video.effective_prompt: [# Sources <VIDEO_0>@Video1] [# References <IMAGE_REF_0>@Image1] Turn this original 3D walk into live-action cinema using Image1 for the photographic finish. Retain Video1's camera, walking motion and exact scene layout. Keep the complete two-storey building on the left and the large Calgary skyline at the same apparent scale and positions. Real people, detailed materials, natural planting and crisp neutral daylight. One continuous four-second shot. Use Image1 only as appearance references for photographic materials, lighting and surface detail, not as first or last frames. Video1 controls the camera path, timing, motion, scene layout, building silhouettes and apparent sizes. Keep every building and skyline landmark in its original position; do not copy a reference viewpoint or introduce its objects. One continuous photographic shot.
video.output_resolution_note: Requested 1080p; delivered media measured at 1920x1080. Provider documents this output setting as upscaled.

visual_review.inspection: Viewed full still and native frame before video admission; inspected output at0/1/2/3seconds, native/output comparison, and browser playback
visual_review.result: Stronger subjective result than previous D: large close skyline retained, complete two-storey building present, photographic people/materials/planting throughout sampled frames
limitations: Fine facade, clothing and planting details are reinterpreted
Camera/actor/prop placement and geometry are not certified pixel-exact
Different source recipe and prompts from D; this is not a controlled single-variable comparison
One scene and one paid video do not establish reliability across the student catalogue
